# Student Clarification Record

## Source
Follow-up statement from Candidate A.

## Date
2 Sep 2026

## Context
Candidate A was asked to clarify which glasses they wore during the Tutorial 5 assessment after a pair of smart glasses was later submitted for examination.

## Statement
Candidate A stated that the glasses worn during the assessment were **not** the same pair as device DF-26-091.

The student said their usual prescription glasses had been damaged on the morning of the assessment after being dropped while getting ready.

According to Candidate A, they used a backup pair of dark-framed prescription glasses for the assessment. The student said the backup pair looked similar to DF-26-091 but did not have any electronic functionality.

Candidate A stated that DF-26-091 was not being worn during the assessment.

When asked where the backup pair was currently located, Candidate A said they were unsure because the pair had been placed aside after the assessment and may have been left at home or discarded.

Candidate A provided a screenshot of a message sent at 08:14 on the morning of the assessment to a friend stating:

> "Dropped my glasses this morning. Great timing."

The message does not identify which pair was damaged or which pair was later worn in the assessment room.
